name: personal-exploration-map
description: A passive-first personal mapping app where explored space becomes the user's own map.

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:engine && npm run test:experience && npm run test:sqlite
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:engine && npm run typecheck:experience && npm run typecheck:sqlite
scripts.check:expo: cd apps/mobile && npx expo install --check && npx --yes expo-doctor
scripts.check: npm run check:governance && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:mobile-boundary && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.mobile:check: npm run check && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run check:expo
scripts.mobile:prebuild:android: cd apps/mobile && npx expo prebuild --platform android --clean --no-install
